scopes.title: Position-aware Graph Neural Networks
scopes.scope: §§3.1–3.2,4.1–4.3 and5.3: definitions/local versus global position, anchor message functions, selection law, distance transform and stated complexity; proofs and full Algorithm1 not audited
scopes.limits: Bourgain and expressivity theorem statements exposed, no proof adoption. Native anchor sets resample each forward; proposal freezes a finite panel and does not inherit distortion guarantees. Source complexity prose for ordinaryGNNs is not adopted as a runtime bound. arXiv abstract comments identify ICML2019; accepted-version body equivalence unverified.

scopes.title: Subgraph Neural Networks
scopes.scope: §§3–4 including definitions, property-aware anchor/channel messages and implementation/extension prose; appendices/Algorithm1/triangular-walk details unopened
scopes.limits: Subgraph classification, not the current node-member bank. Separate channels and shared graph-wide anchors explicit; shared parameter equality across all channels and predictive member ensemble not inferred. Its implementation uses pretrained node embeddings; its §4.3 explicitly permits end-to-end embeddings. Proposal adopts neither donor training nor pretrained teacher acquisition. Published-version equivalence unverified.

scope_selection: Title/abstract and heading inventories used for discovery. Semantic reading limited to retained blocks; no experiments/results section opened.
